scripts.pack:test: npm run pack:bump && npm run build && npm run pack
scripts.check:js: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const path=require('node:path');function walk(d){return fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e=>{const p=path.join(d,e.name);return e.isDirectory()?walk(p):p.endsWith('.js')?[p]:[]})}for(const f of walk('BP/scripts')){require('node:child_process').execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check',f],{stdio:'inherit'})}console.log('JS syntax OK')"
scripts.check:json: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const path=require('node:path');function walk(d){return fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e=>{const p=path.join(d,e.name);return e.isDirectory()?walk(p):p.endsWith('.json')?[p]:[]})}for(const f of walk('.')){JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'))}console.log('JSON OK')"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run check:js && npm run check:json
